method: Deterministic extraction from the existing one-run-per-case traces; no new model runs or judging.

definitions.Acc_avg: For N questions and K independent runs: sum_{i=1..N,r=1..K} correct[i,r] / (N*K). Paper uses K=8.
definitions.Best_at_k: Fraction of questions with at least one correct answer in k independent runs. Not a deployed selector success rate and not k tool calls within one episode.
definitions.correctness: Paper uses GPT-o4-mini semantic judgment against reference natural-language answers. Current 13/20 uses a local coding-assistant review, not that judge.
definitions.tool_calls: Count each on_tool_start once, including parallel calls separately and the rejected 11th text search. Non-error counts are reported separately. All 20 evaluated attempts, including no-answer dev_35, remain in denominator.
definitions.both_tools: At least one run_sql and one contexthub_search with context_type=resource. Schema-only search does not count as text retrieval. Presence does not prove correctness or dependency.
definitions.comparison_limit: Paper uses run_sql for schema discovery as well as data queries. Our schema search/read calls must not simply be removed to make the total look comparable; APIs and fixtures differ.
